_note: Signed off by accounting on 2026-11-19 (20261119 plan, sign-off delta, SO-20; AC-7.6). Reviewed before the release: `bun run seed:welld-ch --dry-run` prints what it would add. Applied only where nothing exists yet: an account number or a VAT code that is already there is never touched. Account names are taken verbatim from the WellD CH chart of accounts in the register (2026-11-19). The VAT code labels and the names IPM26 and IPM38 (2.6 % and 3.8 %) are the operator's, written from the rates until accounting confirms them: a later change is a new code and a deactivation in the app (AC-1.7), no deploy. The codes of the first draft are retired and not in it. The default accounts of the expense types are Refund's own: refund-api/scripts/data/accounting-defaults.welld-ch.json, and a test keeps the two files in agreement.
